network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs through Bubblewrap with --unshare-net, a read-only host filesystem, only its disposable module directory writable, and fixed LANG, LC_ALL, and TZ. Host-side hash and Git checks make no network request.
scope_boundary: Network-isolated trust-zero replay over the pinned shared warm dependency cache. It validates the exact statement transport, conditional composition, local representative body, and two separately implemented same-worker refutations of the frozen value-estimate interface; it does not close the exact root or satisfy cold-hermetic, complete-trust, or distinct-runner gates.
